'''Matti Riecks''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Colorado State Championship]] on 29 April 2000, according to John Arendt's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d644">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-colorado-states-april-29thd644/ colorado-states-april-29th], DeckTech (John "Crash Beedo" Arendt, 1 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-01-colorado-states-april-29thd644/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
